direction.camera: Guide attention with impact rhythm; use a deliberate hold, a measured approach and a stable payoff.
direction.composition: isolate a clear action silhouette before each impact beat; keep one dominant focal hierarchy and legible supporting evidence.
direction.editing: Open with graphic silhouette; alternate proof and breathing room, then resolve with readable hit.
direction.lighting: short high-contrast hit; preserve subject contour and separate it from the supporting field.
direction.materials: ink-like shapes and hot emissive accents; actual material appearance comes from approved imagery or a real 3D asset.
direction.sound: Create a restrained rhythm around quick contrast; place licensed accents on intentional cuts and keep speech clear.
direction.typography: Use impact rhythm,graphic silhouette,compressed action,bold accent,quick contrast,readable hit as hierarchy cues; keep display copy short and body copy readable at final delivery size.
